note: Source vocals live in raw/ and are converted once into her voice in sofia/. A source is normally a finished mix, so `stems: mix` separates the vocal, converts only that, and remixes it over the untouched backing. Every entry must declare `rights`: 'internal_only' or 'commercial' — after conversion the two are indistinguishable files, so the moment of import is the only time the answer is known.

songs.title: Taking My Sweet Time
songs.lyrics:
So I'm taking up the whole sidewalk,
taking my sweet time, taking my own walk.
You can keep your quiet little box —
I've got somewhere better to be.
songs.origin: Suno free tier, downloaded 2026-08-11. Lyrics written for this project.
songs.licence_note: Suno free tier: grants NO commercial rights. Demo, review and internal testing only. Re-generate on a paid plan and change rights to 'commercial' before any published or monetised use.
songs.pitch_note: vocal shifted into her register with RVC and the backing shifted the same amount with ffmpeg, so the two stay in key. Measured 0.4604 before, 0.5992 after.

register.advice: the vocal lands at 311 Hz, +7.7 semitones from her register (165-235 Hz), so it will be transposed -8 — the voice by RVC and the backing by resampling, together, so they stay in the same key. Generated vocals land here almost every time: three tracks measured 297, 311 and 290 Hz, and asking the generator for a lower register moved it by 7 Hz across three attempts. Set auto_key to false on the entry to skip it.

songs.lyrics:
Nothing has to be solved tonight,
nothing has to be figured out right.
Just breathe with me, let the hour go —
I'm not going anywhere, you know.
